name: m26_edge
notes: loss and peak_rel relative to the same chip without a comb (aperture at the FAC exit); xt_*: largest atom-plane intensity within +/-0.5 um of that distance, relative to the peak (1D, single tweezer, as m13 fill); row_shift_nm: centroid of the > 50% part of the profile.

inputs.aperture_plane: FAC exit, f_FAC before S (thin sine-condition lens, CHOICE)
inputs.window: slot: |y| < a (interleaving comb, both edges at the same z); edge: y < a (one edge, block combining)
